parsed.rationale: The ECG shows very tall R waves in aVL, I, V5 and V6 and very deep S waves in V1–V3, so the voltage criteria for LVH are met. There is also left axis deviation and a strain pattern (ST depression and T inversion in I and aVL). The ST elevation in V1–V3 is discordant to the deep S waves, which is expected with LVH, and there is no reciprocal pattern to suggest STEMI.
